title: Cybersecurity Support Services
naics_text: Primary NAICS 541512 - Computer Systems Design Services; Secondary 541519
description: This requirement is a Total Small Business Set-Aside with preference for SDVOSB firms. Services align with GSA Schedule SINs 54151S, 54151HACS. Offerors must demonstrate CMMC Level 2 / cyber compliance readiness. Past performance in federal cybersecurity engagements required.
